calibration.reason: Clear labels and legibility support the task; the familiar layout limits originality, and misplaced focus after an invalid number is a meaningful usability defect.

primary_action.input: Tab to the selected 4 m radio, then ArrowRight.
primary_action.expected: Select 6 m and show all three closure outcomes.
primary_action.observed: 6 m was selected with visible focus; the riverside path, ferry and footbridge outcomes appeared.

A-1440.edge_observation: Two ArrowLeft presses selected 2 m. Only the riverside path closure remained. The water line aligned with the 2 m mark and was identifiable within five seconds.
A-1440.fact_check: At 6 m, the visible water line meets the 6 m mark near the tank top. The listed outcomes match the requested scenario; their real-world accuracy is unsupported by this review.
A-1440.strength: The physical scale study gives the thresholds a distinctive, tangible form.
A-1440.weakness: The 2 m guide label crowds the closure heading area, and the long gap between marks and tank makes comparison less immediate.
A-1440.repair: Give the scale labels a dedicated column and extend unobtrusive guide lines toward the water contact.

primary_action.expected: Select 6 m and show all three closure outcomes.
primary_action.observed: 6 m was selected and all three outcomes were readable in the first 390 × 844 viewport.

A-390.edge_observation: Two ArrowLeft presses selected 2 m; only the riverside path closure remained. The water line aligned with the 2 m mark and could be identified within five seconds, although the image and labels were small.
A-390.fact_check: The 6 m water contact aligns with the top mark. The closure statements match the requested scenario; independent real-world verification was not available.
A-390.strength: The controls, results and scale study all fit in the first viewport.
A-390.weakness: The miniature tank and small threshold labels make the visual comparison less comfortable.
A-390.repair: Enlarge the scale study or simplify the labels while retaining the results above it.

B-390.weakness: Fine details in the ferry and terrain become small at this width.

preference.reason: Both views support the keyboard task and show all three mobile outcomes. B makes the relationship between water height and recognizable crossings quicker to read at both widths, with larger, more direct scale labels.
